hero.byline: by Brie Hollingsworth Krebs  ·  illustrated by Elle Harting

story.heading: the story
story.paragraph_1: A playful and wacky take on big love and even bigger favorites from your toddler's point of view.
story.paragraph_2: Share the silly, sweet and sticky things every kiddo loves the most, never forgetting their most mostest is YOU.
story.image_alt: a bunny with a bowl of macaroni

signup.prompt: psst... want a heads-up when the next book lands? new releases, events, and the occasional happy dance.
signup.thanks: you’re on the list! a hello is on its way.

favorites.heading: peek inside
favorites.intro: a little peek at the mostest things inside. go on, poke around.

images.alt: I could soar, I could roar on the highest swing
then donkey rides on my bicycle
I could race in space on rocket ships with my wings
silly and free outdoor pee pee
because I looove getting messy and muddy

comesayhi.text: we started doing readings, come say hi in person.
